title: Deposition of matrix using an M5 TM sprayer for high resolution MALDI analysis
author: Martin Dufresne
materials: Set the method in the HTX software: 1350 mm/min nozzle velocity 1.5 mm track spacing 0.05 mL/min flow rate CC pattern 4 passes 40 mm nozzle height No drying time
Dispose of syringes in biohazard container
Shut down HTX software and close the computer. Turn off the TM sprayer.

steps.title: Prepare slides
steps.instruction: Remove slides from freezer, place in desiccator for 30 minutes, then acquire an autofluorescence image on the Zeiss AxioScan Z1 (Pre‑IMS Autofluorescence Microscopy).

steps.title: Configure sprayer
steps.instruction: Set nitrogen flow to 8 psi, turn on the M5 TM sprayer, set nozzle temperature to 60 °C and, if applicable, heated stage temperature to 45 °C.

steps.title: Clean sample loop (initial)
steps.instruction: With sprayer in “load” mode, flush the sample loop with 10 mL methanol, then switch to “spray” mode and spray for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare matrix solution
steps.instruction: Make matrix solution at 12 mg/mL in 60 % THF / 40 % acetone containing 5 µL/mL DMF; sonicate for 10 minutes. (Concentration and solvent composition may vary by sample.)

steps.title: Load matrix into loop
steps.instruction: Set sprayer to “load” and load 2 mL of the matrix solution into the sample loop using a syringe.

steps.title: Prime spray and verify
steps.instruction: Switch sprayer to “spray” and spray for ~30 seconds; verify matrix spray by placing a glass slide under the nozzle.

steps.title: Mount slide on stage
steps.instruction: Tape the slide onto the heated stage and adjust the spray area in the HTX software.

steps.title: Run matrix deposition
steps.instruction: Highlight the deposition method, press Start under the Cycle tab, click Continue, wait for purge delay, and confirm that the nozzle is moving.

steps.title: Post‑deposition handling
steps.instruction: When matrix deposition is finished, remove the slides, store them in a slide box, and press “valve load confirm” in the software.

steps.title: Set cleaning temperatures
steps.instruction: Set TM sprayer nozzle and stage temperatures to 30 °C.

steps.title: Clean loop with solvents
steps.instruction: With sprayer in “load” mode, load 10 mL acetonitrile followed by 10 mL methanol into the loop; set sprayer to “spray” and allow flow for ~5 minutes.

steps.title: Rinse nozzle tip
steps.instruction: Spray methanol onto the nozzle tip, taking care not to touch the tip.

steps.title: Clean stage surface
steps.instruction: Clean the stage with methanol, avoiding direct solvent spray onto the stage.

steps.title: Replace bench liner
steps.instruction: Replace the bench liner in front of the instruments.
